definitions.signature: aggregate_service_requests(double precision,double precision,double precision,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean,text,text,text)
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION citylens.aggregate_service_requests(latitude double precision, longitude double precision, radius_meters double precision, start_time timestamp with time zone, end_time timestamp with time zone, exclude_linked_duplicates boolean DEFAULT false, group_by text DEFAULT 'service_name'::text, service_name_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text, status_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(service_name text, status text, request_id_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF latitude IS NULL OR NOT latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90
        OR longitude IS NULL OR NOT longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180
        OR radius_meters IS NULL OR NOT radius_meters BETWEEN 0 AND 50000
        OR start_time IS NULL OR end_time IS NULL OR start_time >= end_time
        OR NOT isfinite(start_time) OR NOT isfinite(end_time)
        OR exclude_linked_duplicates IS NULL
        OR group_by IS NULL OR group_by NOT IN ('service_name','status','both') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid coordinate, radius, time interval, duplicate policy or grouping'
            USING ERRCODE='22023';
    END IF;
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH normalized AS (
        SELECT r.service_request_id,
            citylens.normalize_request_category(r.service_name) AS service,
            citylens.normalize_request_category(r.status) AS state
        FROM citylens.service_requests r
        WHERE r.requested_at>=start_time AND r.requested_at<end_time
            AND (NOT exclude_linked_duplicates OR r.parent_id IS NULL)
            AND ST_DWithin(r.location,
                ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude,latitude),4326)::geography,radius_meters)
    ), matching AS (
        SELECT n.service_request_id,
            CASE WHEN group_by IN ('service_name','both') THEN n.service END AS service,
            CASE WHEN group_by IN ('status','both') THEN n.state END AS state
        FROM normalized n
        WHERE (service_name_filter IS NULL OR n.service IS NOT DISTINCT FROM citylens.normalize_request_category(service_name_filter))
          AND (status_filter IS NULL OR n.state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM citylens.normalize_request_category(status_filter))
    )
    SELECT m.service,m.state,count(DISTINCT m.service_request_id)
    FROM matching m GROUP BY m.service,m.state
    ORDER BY m.service COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST,m.state COLLATE "C" NULLS FIRST;
END;
$function$

definitions.signature: count_service_requests(double precision,double precision,double precision,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean)
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION citylens.count_service_requests(latitude double precision, longitude double precision, radius_meters double precision, start_time timestamp with time zone, end_time timestamp with time zone, exclude_linked_duplicates boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Reject NULLs, invalid numeric ranges, infinite dates, and empty/reversed
    -- intervals. SQLSTATE 22023 means invalid_parameter_value for callers/tests.
    IF latitude IS NULL OR NOT latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90
       OR longitude IS NULL OR NOT longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180
       OR radius_meters IS NULL OR NOT radius_meters BETWEEN 0 AND 50000
       OR start_time IS NULL OR end_time IS NULL OR start_time >= end_time
       OR NOT isfinite(start_time) OR NOT isfinite(end_time)
       OR exclude_linked_duplicates IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid coordinates, radius (0..50000 meters), or time interval'
            USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    RETURN (
        -- The primary key already ensures one row per request ID, so count(*)
        -- cannot double-count repeated CSV occurrences after ingestion.
        SELECT count(*) FROM citylens.service_requests r
        -- Half-open intervals avoid counting a boundary timestamp twice when
        -- querying adjacent periods, such as January followed by February.
        WHERE r.requested_at >= start_time AND r.requested_at < end_time
          -- Flag false: NOT false is true, so every parent-link state passes.
          -- Flag true: only rows with no explicit parent link pass. This does
          -- not discover unlinked duplicates or merge records into real issues.
          AND (NOT exclude_linked_duplicates OR r.parent_id IS NULL)
          -- geography uses spheroidal distance in meters by default. Assigning
          -- SRID labels the coordinate system; it does not transform coordinates.
          -- NULL locations cannot satisfy this filter and are not counted.
          AND ST_DWithin(r.location,
              ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude, latitude),4326)::geography,
              radius_meters)
    );
END;
$function$
